source_fields.purpose: Recognize saved-line structural candidates; not select importance or generate explanations.
limits: Previously opened regression corpus; no held-out or reader quality result.
Initial contacts are geometric; legal capture availability uses actual post-root turns.
Different capture availability concerns one immediate capture, not all threats or optimal defenses.
A later capture of the same captor is a physical relation, not sufficient proof of relevance.
Different-square adjacent captures are temporal candidates, not proven compensation or causality.
Promotion identity does not make capture-only material arithmetic valid.
Mirror checks test color independence only; they are not new master-game evidence.
